prompt:
Use case: product-mockup

Asset: Physical badge and lanyard

Composition: 16:9 aspect ratio.

Create a clear product reference sheet showing the approved employee card in a clear rigid portrait-format holder with rounded corners and a simple metal swivel clip, suspended from a plain matte woven burgundy #8b1e2d lanyard. Show front and rear views plus a close-up of the clip. Use the exact supplied front and back artwork; preserve Riley's portrait and all lettering. Provisional card size approximately 54 x 86 mm; lanyard approximately 15 mm wide. Neutral background, realistic plastic reflections that do not obscure the portrait.

Rendering: Photorealistic premium live-action commercial look, physically plausible materials, believable anatomy and construction, controlled contrast, natural detail. No illustration, game screenshot, plastic skin, excessive bloom, or baked-in cinematic motion blur. Reference assets should be sharp enough to inspect. No decorative watermarks; the official contest watermark will be added during final editing.

Reference handling: Use the supplied images in the listed order and for their specified roles. Preserve selected designs; do not invent a new identity or silently replace a missing dependency.

Input images in order: badge-02, badge-03.
review: Visually inspected; retained as test reference. Not user-approved final.
